name: cindy
description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
one_liner: A free desktop AI assistant that actually runs on your own computer and does real work in your apps and files, instead of just chatting with you.
buyer: A solo professional or small-business owner who wants an AI that finishes real computer tasks (filing, scheduling, research) for free, without paying for a cloud AI-agent subscription.
business_use_cases: A virtual-assistant freelancer sets up Cindy on a client's machine to auto-handle recurring admin work (invoice follow-ups, data entry) and charges a monthly retainer for 'AI assistant management.'
A small agency offers a one-time 'Cindy setup' service: installing it, wiring it to a client's tools, and building 2-3 custom automations.
A solo consultant builds and sells packaged skills for a specific niche (real estate intake, legal document prep) once Cindy's extension system matures.

money_ideas.idea: Charge a flat fee to install and configure Cindy plus a handful of custom automations for a non-technical small-business client.
Offer an ongoing 'AI assistant care plan' where you maintain and extend a client's Cindy automations as their workflow changes.

steal_this: Pick one repetitive weekly task a local business owner complains about and build them a paid, one-time Cindy automation for it this weekend.
